note: Bighorn NF campground on Burgess Road (FSR 15) about a mile north of Burgess Junction, in lodgepole pine on the North Fork Tongue River and Big Willow Creek; sites 002, 003 and 006-009 sit on open meadow a few steps from the creek. Run by a concessionaire. --Claude
summary: FS page + recreation.gov 233925: 11 non-electric sites (no 004), 2 pull-throughs, limits 26-100 ft (all take 23 ft+), $18 in 2026-2027 (FS says $20), $9 second vehicle, 002/006 first-come, 2-day cutoff, 14-night limit, hand-pump water + vault toilets, sold Jun 11-Sep 20 2027. Waterfront lead riverview -> creekside (sites 002, 003, 006-009 ~10-25 m from a 2-5 m creek over open meadow). Pin ~125 m from the site centroid - no move.
flags: WATERFRONT lead (riverview -> creekside; not changed): on Esri imagery both channels at the campground are small - the western one beside sites 002 (44.78065,-107.53474) and 003 (44.78034,-107.53511) and the one along the meadow south of 006-009 are 2-5 m wide (the main North Fork Tongue meander ~250 m north of the loop is ~10 m), so nothing here is a river over ~30 m. Sites 002 and 003 sit ~15-20 m from the western channel, and 007 (44.78000,-107.53229), 008 (44.78007,-107.53194) and 009 (44.78010,-107.53157) ~10-20 m from the southern one, all across open meadow grass with no tree band; 006 (44.77995,-107.53253) is at the meadow's west end. recreation.gov tags 002 and 005-009 'Riverfront'. All of these are sold by the night (002 and 006 first-come, the rest reservable). The value should be 'creekside', not 'riverview'.
Fee conflict: FS page 'Single Site: $20 per night' vs recreation.gov $18 for 2026 and 2027 - recreation.gov written.

Site count/lengths: the stored note's 'site 4 double' and '45-75 ft spurs' are not in the catalog - there is no site 004, and limits run 26-100 ft (001 30, 002 26, 003 28, 005 30 ft). Stored max_rig_ft 75 -> 100 (site 009 pull-through, driveway 120 ft). Stored inclusion_evidence '45-75 ft spurs' is slightly off but the conclusion stands.

Phone kept: 307-431-7446 is recreation.gov's facility number for the concessionaire (Rustic Freedom / Gallatin Canyon Campgrounds). Managing office: Bighorn NF Supervisor's and Tongue Ranger District Office (307) 674-2600.
Website links current (FS r02 page + recreation.gov 233925).
FS status 'Site Partially Closed' is the end-of-season state (self-supported camping, no services) - not a closure.
Pin 44.77950,-107.53380 sits in the trees south of the loop; the site centroid is about 44.78025,-107.53260 (~125 m) - no move needed. FS point 44.78074,-107.53395.
FS lists OHV trail riding nearby - a general campground, not a staging camp.
